method: Read-only static source and frozen-contract review plus independent retained-file hash/readback inspection. Reviewer did not execute product or test campaigns. This new review record is the only reviewer write.

prior_findings.finding: Post-dispatch framing/schema/status/exit validation failures could reach main and incorrectly report recorded_may_exist=false.
prior_findings.resolution: Final 69c91ad134e2018fe74bb7cad9f6d5a5574d22b8feddf57d443c3a43a103dc7e preserves dispatch state through launch/temporary cleanup errors and handles post-dispatch validation errors as ambiguous. Separate controlled fault evidence covers the named injected branches.

scope_limits: Main client receipt retains postcommit_fault_injection=UNRUN for its own campaign; additive fault receipt is separate evidence.
Fault origin is a trusted test shim in isolated Python processes; no claim that a real decoder emitted malformed output.
Fault controls use real original-arm source recovery/commit; they do not qualify the same injected faults through the transport decoder.
Disk hashes and an honestly retained external head do not authenticate the host or provide hostile same-user isolation.
No external-user acceptance, security acceptance, formal integration proof or product acceptance is supplied by this review.
verified: Current entry source matches the final held source pin in both reviewed campaigns.

Independent main client tests preserve literal expected inner bytes, adaptive source-linked actions in both actual original/transport arms, durable call accounting, externally held head checks and scoped refusal controls.
Three controlled worker-result faults occur after successful real original-arm worker commits; malformed stdout, truncated stdout and exit disagreement return recorded_may_exist=true.
A controlled prelaunch staging fault returns recorded_may_exist=false with no session or receipt effects.
A controlled receipt-only write fault after a real original-arm direct-worker commit returns recorded_may_exist=true; committed journal remains and receipt is absent.
Source and evidence pins were independently read back; retained client process streams match their observation records.
